description: Discover subdomains passively from Certificate Transparency logs, then resolve each candidate via DNS to mark which are live. crt.sh is the primary source, Certspotter the fallback (crt.sh is frequently overloaded), and the apex domain's own TLS certificate SAN list a third always-available source. Every discovered name carries its source provenance. No DNS brute-forcing — this reads public logs, it does not probe the target's resolvers. Use only on domains you own or are authorized to assess.

includeUnresolved.description: When true, include names that did not resolve. When false, return only live hosts.

limit.description: Requested candidate count; effective limit is min(request, 50, ATTACKSURFACE_MAX_SUBDOMAINS).

offset.description: Offset into current sorted CT candidates; data changes can shift offsets.

sources.description: CT sources to query. Omit for all of crt.sh, certspotter, tls-san.

name: attacksurface_enumerate_subdomains

reason.description: Why this follow-up advances the defensive review.

toolName.description: Registered local tool to call next.

continuation.description: Next enumeration call preserving sources and filter.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `invalid_domain`: The supplied domain is not a syntactically valid registrable domain. `all_sources_failed`: Every requested CT source failed (e.g. crt.sh overloaded and Certspotter rate-limited). Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

examinedCount.description: Candidates resolved on this call, including undelivered suffix.

filteredAddressErrors.description: Operational failures for nonlive candidates filtered out of subdomains; empty when none were filtered.

items.description: A filtered candidate with failed address resolution.

nextOffset.description: Next consumed-candidate offset, or null when exhausted.

oversize.description: One complete record or required metadata exceeds the byte target.

remainingCount.description: Candidates remaining after the consumed prefix.

returnedCount.description: Returned subdomain count after filtering and byte fitting.

complete.description: True when paged source coverage was exhausted.

incompleteReason.description: Reason paged source coverage stopped, or null.

pagesFetched.description: Successfully read pages including an empty terminal page.

sourceError.description: Source error, or null on success.

subdomains.description: Discovered subdomains with provenance and liveness.

items.description: A discovered subdomain with provenance and liveness.

addressError.description: Address-family or blocked-target failure, or null.

resolved.description: True when the name resolved to at least one A/AAAA address.

sources.description: CT source(s) that surfaced this name.

truncated.description: More candidates remain for another page.

title: attacksurface_enumerate_subdomains
